label: Seeded sample: the Feature Design 6.8 worked example, written by hand. The agents do not write it.

conflicts.title: DTI changes with the treatment of overtime
conflicts.detail: DTI is 44.70% with overtime and bonus left out of income, or 41.61% if overtime is counted. The underwriter decides which income to use.

missing_information: Pay stubs for the last 16 days of the 30-day period
Page 3 of the August 2026 bank statement
potential_risks: The funds to close are not yet documented.
A 2,000.00 transfer from an individual has no source on file.
sections.note: Illustrative sample. Every figure comes from a stored calculation; this text carries no decision.

findings.title: Documented assets are 27,273.68 short of the funds to close
findings.detail: Documented assets are 9,226.32 against 36,500.00 needed to close: 36,500.00 - 9,226.32 = 27,273.68.

findings.title: A 2,000.00 transfer on 2026-09-22 has no documented source
findings.detail: A transfer of 2,000.00 from an individual on 2026-09-22 is above the large-deposit minimum and is not payroll.

findings.title: DTI is 44.70%, above the illustrative 43% review level
findings.detail: (1,980.00 + 693.00) / 5,980.00 = 44.70%. With overtime counted the figure is 41.61%.

findings.title: Overtime and bonus are excluded: their history covers 2026 only
findings.detail: Only 2026 is documented for these components, and two years are needed under the illustrative settings.

findings.title: A 30-day late payment appears 19 months before the credit report
findings.detail: The Northgate Card shows one 30-day late payment, 19 months before the report date.

findings.title: The pay stubs cover 16 days fewer than the 30 days required
findings.detail: The documents in the file do not span the full 30-day period on the checklist.

findings.title: Page 3 of the August 2026 bank statement is missing
findings.detail: The statement prints three pages and two were received.

findings.title: The printed net pay was corrected by a reviewer
findings.detail: The stub prints 2,083.61; gross 3,070.50 less deductions 1,036.89 is 2,033.61, which matches the bank deposits.

conditions.text: Provide the source of the 2,000.00 transfer received on 2026-09-22, for example a gift letter and the donor's bank record.
Document the funds to close: 27,273.68 of the 36,500.00 needed is not yet supported by the statements on file.
Provide pay stubs that cover the full 30-day period before the application.
Provide page 3 of the August 2026 bank statement.
Provide documents covering a second year of overtime and bonus history, since 2026 is the only year on file.
Provide a written explanation of the 30-day late payment on the Northgate Card.
